title: India Geopolitical Risk Monitor (IGRM): daily press-salience index for India, five channels, 2017-present
description: A daily, category-decomposed press-salience index for India-related geopolitical risk in the Caldara-Iacoviello article-share tradition: five channels (Pakistan/western border, China/eastern border, Gulf and energy security, US and trade policy, shipping and chokepoints) computed over GDELT coverage since 2017, percentile-normalized against each channel's trailing two years. Includes pre-registered validation against 21 historical episodes, an events-stream layer, chokepoint sub-dictionaries with IMF PortWatch comparison, a pre-registered four-component stress gauge, comparator country series, and a lead-lag predictability study. Measures press salience (attention), not risk; association, never causation.
